acquirer_reference_number.title: Acquirer reference number (ARN)
acquirer_reference_number.description: An ARN is data an acquirer supplies in an acquirer originated message that an issuer may need to return to the acquirer in a subsequent message.

amount_cardholder_billing.title: Amount cardholder billing
amount_cardholder_billing.description: Transaction amount converted to the issuer’s designated cardholder billing currency.

amount_reconciliation.title: Reconciliation amount
amount_reconciliation.description: Reconciliation amount in sender's currency, exclusive of any fees.

amount_transaction.title: Transaction amount
amount_transaction.description: Amount of funds the cardholder requested in the currency appearing on the transaction information document (TID), which may be in the acquirer’s local currency.

card_acceptor_business_code.title: Card acceptor business code
card_acceptor_business_code.description: Card acceptor business code [MCC] classifies the card acceptor's business type.

card_acceptor_name.title: Card acceptor name
card_acceptor_name.description: Card acceptor name or ATM owning institution name.

cycle_id.title: Cycle ID
cycle_id.description: The issuer provides card issuer reference data when processing retrieval or chargeback messages.

file_id.title: File ID
file_id.description: File ID uniquely identifies a logical data file to be exchanged between a customer or processor and the clearing system.

message_number.title: Message number
message_number.description: The transaction originator assigns the DE Message Number to data messages in a file. Message number monitors the integrity and continuity of the files being exchanged.

mti.title: Message type interchange
mti.description: Four-digit numeric field describing the message type being interchanged

processing_code.title: Processing code
processing_code.description: Processing code indicates a transaction's effect on a customer account and the accounts affected.

reversal_flag.title: Reversal Flag
reversal_flag.description: Indicates if the dispute is reversed. This can be `R` or space.

transaction_destination_institution_id_c.title: Transaction destination institution ID code
transaction_destination_institution_id_c.description: Transaction destination institution ID code identifies the transaction destination institution.

transaction_status.title: Transaction Status
transaction_status.description: Success/failure [logged as either SUCCESS or FAILURE]

currency_exponent.title: Currency exponent
currency_exponent.description: Transaction currency code and exponent; reconciliation currency code and exponent; cardholder billing currency code and exponent

event_id.title: Event ID
event_id.description: The issuer provides card issuer reference data when processing retrieval or chargeback messages.

reason_rejection.title: Rejection reason
reason_rejection.description: Failure description - shown only when there is a failure.

reconciliation_currency_code.title: Reconciliation currency code
reconciliation_currency_code.description: Sender reconciliation currency code associated with the sender reconciliation amount

retrieval_reference_number.title: Retrieval reference number
retrieval_reference_number.description: Retrieval reference number is a transaction information document reference number the card acceptor or designated agent supplies.
